name: dumb-llm-autocomplete
description: AI-powered inline code completions via any OpenAI-compatible API.

dumbLlmAutocomplete.apiEndpoint.description: Base URL of the server. The right path is appended automatically based on apiStyle: /v1/chat/completions for chat, /api/generate for ollama-native. Examples: http://localhost:11434, https://api.openai.com, http://localhost:1234. Legacy full-path values still work.

dumbLlmAutocomplete.model.description: Model identifier to send in the request.

dumbLlmAutocomplete.maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate.

dumbLlmAutocomplete.debounceMs.description: Delay before sending a request. Only the latest call after a typing burst reaches the API.

dumbLlmAutocomplete.contextLines.description: Lines of context before and after the cursor included in the prompt.

dumbLlmAutocomplete.maxPromptTokens.description: Soft cap on prompt size in tokens. Prefix/suffix are pruned to fit.

dumbLlmAutocomplete.multiline.description: When to ask the model for a multi-line completion. 'auto' skips mid-expression (e.g. after '.' or '(') and only asks multi-line at the start of a statement.

dumbLlmAutocomplete.useCache.description: Cache completions to a local file by file prefix. Speeds up re-requests when the user types the start of an earlier completion.

dumbLlmAutocomplete.debug.description: Log every completion to the 'Dumb LLM autocomplete' output channel (language, multiline, snippet). Useful for diagnosing 'no completion shows up' issues.

dumbLlmAutocomplete.apiStyle.description: Appends either `/v1/chat/completions` (openai-compatible, default) or `/api/generate` (ollama-native) to apiEndpoint. `ollama-native` is required for FIM tokens on Ollama-served models like qwen2.5-coder — the OpenAI-compat endpoint ignores FIM markers.

dumbLlmAutocomplete.systemPrompt.default:
You are an autocomplete engine.

Complete the code at the cursor.

Return only the text to insert.

Do not explain.

Do not repeat existing code.

Do not wrap in markdown.

Keep the completion minimal.

Preserve formatting.
dumbLlmAutocomplete.systemPrompt.description: System prompt sent with every request.
